svg.desc: Isometric contribution terrain for @maeul-sky from 2025-01-05 to 2026-01-03. 1,582 contributions across 269 active days. 3 wonders discovered. relative normalization, maximum 11. Terrain height represents contribution count; terrain colors follow the seasons. Village collection. In this landscape: 3 unique Wonders. 30 catalog types; 27 not seen here. Discovered: Meteor crater (Epic); Giant bonsai (Epic); Hot spring (Rare). Seasonal auras in this landscape: Spring petals; Summer fireflies; Autumn leaves; Winter frost.
